_comment: The MCP interface for AI agents that control a Nintendo Switch.
Shared by both MCP servers so they expose exactly the same tools:
- the SerialPrograms app ('AI Agent Server' program in the ML tab): host 'app'
Each tool lists the hosts that implement it. 'inputSchema' is the JSON Schema
sent to agents in tools/list; both servers validate arguments against it.
Input steps (buttons, sticks, durations) follow the vocabulary in
AgentInputTestCases.json, which both implementations are tested against.
instructions: You control a real Nintendo Switch through a USB device that acts as a controller, and see its screen through a capture card.
- Call `screenshot` first to see where you are.

- Input tools (`press_buttons`, `move_stick`, `run_inputs`) return a screenshot taken `settle_ms` after the inputs finished, unless observe=false. Prefer `run_inputs` to send several steps in one call when you are confident about them (e.g. navigating a known menu).
- Use `read_text` to read on-screen text reliably instead of reading it off a screenshot.
- If a tool says the user has taken control, stop sending inputs. The user is steering the console by hand; check `switch_status` later to see when control is returned.
- Buttons: A B X Y L R ZL ZR PLUS MINUS HOME CAPTURE LCLICK RCLICK. D-pad: UP DOWN LEFT RIGHT (and UP_RIGHT etc.). Combine with "+", e.g. "L+R" or "ZL+A".
- Sticks: direction names (up, down_left, ...) or [x, y] in [-1, 1], +y = up.
- Boxes: [x, y, width, height] as fractions of the screen, (0, 0) = top-left.
- Menus usually need a short press (hold 80 ms) and ~300-800 ms to animate. Walking is done by holding a stick for a duration.
- Switch UI: A = confirm, B = back, HOME = Home menu, X on Home menu = close game.
- A black screen may mean the Switch is asleep; ask the user to wake it.

box.description: Crop box [x, y, width, height] as fractions of the screen; omit for the full screen.

settle_ms.description: Wait this long after the inputs before the screenshot (default from server config).

tools.name: switch_status
tools.description: Report controller and video connection status, resolution, who is in control, and limits.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List serial ports (controller devices) and video capture devices.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: (Re)connect to the controller and/or video device. Omitted arguments keep the current setting. Use after unplugging a device or to switch devices.

serial_port.description: Serial port of the controller device.

video_device.description: Video device index or name substring.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture the current screen as a JPEG. Crop with `box` to zoom into details.

tools.name: wait_and_observe
tools.description: Wait without pressing anything (e.g. for a loading screen), then screenshot.

tools.name: read_text
tools.description: Read on-screen text with OCR. Crop tightly around the text with `box` for best results.

mode.description: "line" for one line, "block" for a paragraph, "sparse" for scattered text.

tools.name: press_buttons
tools.description: Press a button combination, optionally several times.

tools.name: move_stick
tools.description: Tilt a stick for a duration (walk, move a cursor, turn the camera), optionally while holding buttons.

direction.description: Direction name ("up", "down_left", ...) or [x, y] in [-1, 1], +y = up.

duration_ms.description: How long to hold the stick.

buttons.description: Buttons to hold at the same time, e.g. "B" to run.

tools.name: run_inputs
tools.description: Run a sequence of input steps back to back, then optionally screenshot. Example: [{"buttons": "DOWN", "repeat": 3}, {"buttons": "A"}, {"wait_ms": 1000}, {"left_stick": "up", "hold_ms": 2000, "release_ms": 0}]

items.description: One input step. Set `buttons` and/or sticks to press something, or only `wait_ms` to pause.

buttons.description: Buttons and/or d-pad to hold together, e.g. "A", "L+R", "ZL+UP".

left_stick.description: Left stick: direction name ("up", "down_left") or [x, y] in [-1, 1].

right_stick.description: Right stick (camera in most games), same format as left_stick.

hold_ms.description: How long to hold the inputs.

release_ms.description: Neutral time after releasing, before the next step.

repeat.description: Repeat this press/release cycle this many times.

wait_ms.description: Extra pause after the step (or the whole step if nothing is pressed).

tools.name: release_all
tools.description: Emergency stop: cancel queued inputs and release every button and stick, then wait briefly for the device to confirm.

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Recent log lines (connection status, inputs, errors).
